answer_1.quote: We focus on the data composition problem among mathematical reasoning, code generation, and general human-aligning abilities in SFT...
answer_1.outputs: Generated math solutions, code snippets, and dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: We use the default test set to measure large language model math reasoning ability... We calculate the score based on greedy decoding accuracy (maj@1). For code generation we report Pass@k on HumanEval. MT-Bench scores are obtained via GPT-4.

answer_3.quote: MT-Bench evaluates LLMs on multi-turn dialogues ... and relies on GPT-4 for scoring.
